_doc: Dong bo kho SFX + Meme tu Cloudflare R2 (cong khai, CHI DE TAI). base_url = URL r2.dev / custom domain cua bucket. App tai {base_url}/library-manifest.json + {base_url}/sfx/<file> + {base_url}/memes/<file>. Upload (publish) dung token rieng o may tac gia (~/.capcut-studio/r2-publish.json), KHONG nhung vao app. Doi bucket: sua base_url o day roi npm run dist.
